title: Does anybody know some free gritty tileset s for RPG Maker MV that make for a good horror/dreadful atmosphere?

posts.author: ambr_
posts.body:
I'm starting work on a prototype/prequel for a larger game I want to make, and I think RPG Maker MV would be the best medium to set up lore/worldbuilding and foundational mechanics for my game since it is quite easy to use.
While my game won't necessarily be a horror one, it will focus a lot on building up tension and the dreadful atmosphere of a post apocalyptic fantasy world, and while I like the natural look of the base tilesets, I think their colorful nature take away from the atmosphere I want to build up. I want a tileset that has gritty and discolored textures, preferably textures that would be found in a medieval city like cobblestone, bricks, and ground devoid of any vegetation. If I could give any examples for the vibes I want to go for, the Fear & Hunger games and the Dark Souls franchise would be good examples.
If it helps with finding an appropriate tileset, the game is set in the middle ages, after an event called The Sixth Cataclysm devastated the world even further than it already was, in this game you play as a mother in search of her daughter in a city called Graustadt. The game will have souls-like gameplay elements and will be quite difficult, and I want the visuals to amplify the feel of the dreadful situation the main character is put in. Paid tilesets would be good as well, but I'd like a free one more.

posts.author: The_Eerie_One
posts.body:
Maybe try looking at refmap - it already has a darker, more subdued color pallet than the RTP, and has plenty of free options via their
blog
as well as paid DLCs you can get later if needed.
They even have this free tileset for making a witch's house that could prove helpful.
And their paid autumn set might be the right vibes you're going for?
